sources.notes: Fresh raw Next.js React Flight owner data fetched2026-10-13 (fetch date; no board-wide update timestamp). Complete exact-version collection preserves every published measured effort at full precision, exact-run speed, costs and original fallback telemetry. Canonical release metadata plus explicit effort.slug is read from owner model detail catalog; older versions, estimated indexes and multi-model coding agents are excluded. No synthetic fallback-adjusted score. Muse Wonder and Full each publish max only; Full has no USD/task, token pricing or output-speed evidence. Host checkpoint and canonical modelRelease are preserved, including null canonical mappings with explicit owner release display. Prior same-variant/value effort metadata dates remain visible when reused. Source snapshot dates do not claim models were rerun on fetch day.

gemini-4-argon.name: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index
gemini-4-argon.notes: Additive exact-version Gemini 4 Argon collection from raw owner Next.js React Flight fetched 2026-10-13. updated is fetch date, not a claim of rerunning models. All 699 Intelligence/detail catalog models and 39 coding agent rows inspected; exactly one measured high effort run per board. Full raw precision, cost and safety telemetry retained. Canonical Intelligence model release is gemini-4-argon; owner model metadata releaseDate is 2026-09-30. No median output speed is published. Coding explicitly displays Gemini 4 Argon but modelRelease remains barium-bb and host google_barium-bb_ai-studio, with unavailable flag true; mapping is based on the evaluator explicit released-name display and raw identifiers remain visible. Coding fallbackAttemptCount is 0 of 905; no fallback-adjusted score is synthesized. Individual Intelligence components stay inside the composite and are not additional consensus boards.
gemini-4-argon.costDateBasis: Fetch date; no board-wide timestamp published
